name: Rosebud Yacht Club
signature: A family-focused bay sailing club with active racing and one of the Peninsula's best junior sailing programs
editorNote:
Rosebud Yacht Club sits on the bay foreshore at Rosebud and is one of the Peninsula's most accessible sailing clubs for families and beginners. The calm bay water makes it ideal for learning — no ocean swell, manageable breezes, and a club environment that is genuinely welcoming to newcomers.

The junior sailing program is strong and well-established, running through the summer season with structured coaching for kids from about 8 years upward. Adult learn-to-sail courses run in parallel.
whyWeGo: The most accessible entry point to bay sailing on the Peninsula — calm water and a welcoming club culture.
ifOnlyOneThing: Ask about the junior sailing program if you have kids — Rosebud YC is one of the better entry points on the bay.
